_comment: Per-stack additions to the baseline CSP in _headers.example. Merged additively into the directive arrays in lib/headers.sh / lib/audit_project.sh. 'baseline' below is what every stack starts from; overlays add to it.

nextjs.dev._note: Development only — `next dev` uses eval-based HMR. NEVER ship 'unsafe-eval' in prod.

nextjs.prod._note: Production. 'unsafe-inline' on script-src is required until you adopt nonce-based CSP via middleware. Replace with 'nonce-XXXX' as soon as feasible.

astro._note: Astro's component-scoped CSS is inline; baseline already allows that on style-src. No script-src additions needed for static islands.

sveltekit._note: SvelteKit hydration injects inline scripts. Move to nonce-aware CSP via hooks.server.ts when feasible.

remix._note: Remix's hydration emits inline scripts. Same nonce migration recommendation as SvelteKit.

nuxt._note: Nuxt's Nitro runtime + hydration. Baseline + 'unsafe-inline' on script-src; tighten via Nitro nonce hook later.

stripe-elements._note: Stripe Elements / Stripe.js. Required exact origins: js.stripe.com, hooks.stripe.com, api.stripe.com. Frame both js.stripe.com and hooks.stripe.com.

cloudflare-turnstile._note: Cloudflare Turnstile loads scripts and frames from challenges.cloudflare.com.
